description: Arithmetic with rounding. Nothing is missing from the purpose, so the author should ask nothing and the tool should be saved with passing tests.

input.name: splitBill
input.purpose: Split a restaurant bill evenly. The tip is tipPercent percent of the total. Return an object `{ tip: number, totalWithTip: number, perPerson: number }`, each rounded to 2 decimal places, where perPerson is totalWithTip divided by people. When people is less than 1, return `{ error: "people must be at least 1" }`.
input.request: { total: number; tipPercent: number; people: number }
